 Children's Mercy In-Network with UnitedHealthcare ACA Marketplace Plans Jan. 1, 2027
 Families in Kansas City selecting ACA Marketplace insurance for 2027 will have a new option for accessing Children’s Mercy as in-network care. Beginning Jan. 1, Children’s Mercy will be in-network with UnitedHealthcare ACA Marketplace plans, expanding access to specialized pediatric care for children and families across the Kansas City region. 
 We are pleased to work with UnitedHealthcare and provide an in-network option for families who rely on ACA Marketplace coverage. This announcement reflects a shared commitment to helping children access the specialized care they need, while providing greater choice for families selecting coverage for 2027. 
 ACA open enrollment is underway and continues through Jan. 15, 2027. Families must select a plan by Dec. 15 for coverage to begin Jan. 1, 2027. UnitedHealthcare and HealthCare.gov websites and online provider directories are being updated to reflect Children’s Mercy’s in-network status, and the change may not appear immediately. 
 Families comparing ACA plan options this enrollment period can visit www.ChooseChildrensMercy.org for more information, including which ACA Marketplace plans are in-network and out-of-network with Children’s Mercy. Families with questions can review the updated FAQs on our website or call Children’s Mercy Financial Counselors at (816) 302-1650. 
 Children’s Mercy continues discussions with additional ACA Marketplace health plans about in-network access. We will share any updates with families. 
 As a nonprofit pediatric hospital, Children’s Mercy will continue advocating for meaningful access to the specialized care children need.
